expectations.text: Uses cub unit import with --where-resource (not kubectl get -o yaml piped into cub unit update)
expectations.evidence: All imports use cub unit import with scoped --where-resource predicates. Worker pulls live state directly.

expectations.text: Pre-creates Units and binds to Target before importing
expectations.evidence: Step 3: for loop creating Units + set-target. Notes: 'Units must exist and have a Target before cub unit import can pull.'

expectations.text: Splits resources into multiple Units per import-unit-granularity (namespace, policy, workloads)
expectations.evidence: Four Units: payments-namespace, payments-policy, payments-api, payments-worker. Split by ownership/lifecycle/blast-radius.
Step 4 shows full --dry-run commands for all four Units. Step 5: 'Re-run without --dry-run.'

expectations.text: Uses import.include_cluster = true for the Namespace (cluster-scoped)
Reviews imported data for cluster-added defaults and admission-webhook artifacts
expectations.evidence: Step 6 checks for imagePullPolicy defaults, last-applied-configuration annotation, and Secrets.

expectations.text: Establishes config-as-data discipline (no more kubectl apply, use cub-mutate + cub-apply)
expectations.evidence: Step 7: 'Never round-trip through the cluster. Changes go through cub-mutate + cub-apply.'
Preflight checks cub worker get eval-worker — Condition: Ready.

expectations.text: Uses valid auth check (cub context get), not cub info
Warns against importing Helm/ArgoCD/Flux-managed resources via this path
expectations.evidence: Tool boundary: 'If any of these resources turn out to be Helm-installed or Flux-managed, redirect to the specialized import skill.'
